response:
关闭开关后，明细字段会隐藏，但其中的值仍保留为 `保留内容`，并且不参与必填校验；点击按钮只会准备一份**可编辑草稿**，不会自动发送。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form, ask])
$on: boolean = false
$name: string = ""
$detail: string = "保留内容"
form = Form(children=[toggle, nameField, detailField], title="旅行同行人条件")
toggle = Switch(bind=$on, label="启用同行人明细")
nameField = TextField(bind=$name, label="同行人姓名", required=true)
detailField = TextField(bind=$detail, label="同行人明细", required=true, visible=$on)
ask = Button(label="准备检查草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请检查这份旅行同行人条件表单。", context={"name":$name,"enabled":$on,"detail":$detail}))
```
